ambient: The loop shortens by a beat.

description: This has happened before. It's happening. It has happened before. The room is a short piece of tape spliced end to end and you're somewhere in the middle of the splice, going round, finding it funnier each time.
name: The Loop

It's a short loop and getting shorter.
